highlights.topic: Trump rejects Iran's Hormuz reopening offer
highlights.cause: Departing the White House for Knoxville, Trump said Iran "made a proposal but I rejected it". Iran offered to reopen Hormuz in 7 days for a blockade lift, oil-sanction waiver and ceasefire.
highlights.effect: No Hormuz reopening. Blockade stays. Truth post 08:18 ET: "IRAN CAN NOT HAVE A NUCLEAR WEAPON".
highlights.expect: Oil bid Sunday night; WTI upside risk into Monday 09:30 ET open. Watch any counter-offer through the UN mediators.

highlights.topic: US–China: $30B tariff cuts, truce to 10 Jan, chips untouched
highlights.cause: Xi's 3-day Washington visit ended. Both sides cut tariffs on $30B of non-sensitive goods; truce extended to 10 Jan 2027; AI incident channel agreed.
highlights.effect: Ag, seafood, wood, cosmetics, medical devices gain China access; toys and small appliances gain U.S. access. Export controls and Nvidia-class chips not in the deal.
highlights.expect: Stability, not a breakthrough. Chip and export-control names get no relief. Next catalysts: Trump to China in Nov, G20 Miami in Dec.

highlights.topic: Bessent stays at Treasury, no AI czar move
highlights.cause: Truth post denying the report that Scott Bessent becomes "Super Intelligence Czar".
highlights.effect: Treasury leadership unchanged. Already priced in by Friday close.

highlights.topic: AI CEO meeting Tue 29 Sep with Speaker Johnson
highlights.cause: Axios and Reuters report Trump, Johnson and tech CEOs meet at the White House on AI safety, guardrails and competitiveness. Time not announced.
highlights.effect: AI names (NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL, ORCL) headline risk Tuesday. Any "slow down" language is the risk; any deregulation language is the upside.
highlights.expect: Headlines from ~midday Tuesday. Trump's own readout likely on Truth Social the same evening.

roadmap.title: Tennessee vs Texas game, Neyland Stadium, Knoxville
roadmap.note: Off-market weekend appearance. Press remarks on departure already delivered (Iran).

roadmap.title: UN General Assembly speeches end; no Trump event posted
roadmap.note: Iran counter-proposal via UN mediators possible. First market session after the Hormuz rejection.

roadmap.title: AI meeting: Trump, Speaker Johnson, tech CEOs
roadmap.note: Reported by Axios, Reuters, ABC. Attendees not confirmed; OpenAI and Anthropic named. AI safety and guardrails on the agenda.

roadmap.title: Fiscal year ends, no shutdown risk
roadmap.note: Continuing resolution passed 1 Sep funds government to 11 Dec 2026.

roadmap.title: Trump state visit to China (APEC, Shenzhen likely)
roadmap.note: Announced by Trump 25 Sep 13:17 ET. Chips, export controls and Taiwan left for this round.

roadmap.title: Continuing resolution expires
roadmap.note: Next shutdown deadline. Post-midterm lame-duck session.

roadmap.title: G20 Miami; Trump–Xi meeting
roadmap.note: Third Trump–Xi meeting of the cycle, on U.S. soil.

roadmap.title: US–China trade truce expires
roadmap.note: Extended at the Washington summit. Bessent: room for a "broader agreement" before then.
